clips.motion: THEY MEET: on the golden campus path his armful of books slips and scatters; she stops and kneels to help him gather them; their eyes meet over the books and both smile; he helps her up and they begin walking together, talking easily.

They walk on together through the campus as the light turns amber, talking and laughing, her shoulder bumping his; the path flows past them; they slow to a stop beneath an old lamp post and he gently tucks a strand of hair behind her ear.

ALONE: the young man walks a rainy night street with his hands jammed in his jacket pockets, head down, streetlights smearing in the wet; THE WORLD SHIFTS AROUND HIM as the street dissolves into a small city rooftop at night where he leans on the parapet alone, city lights blurred and distant.
The rooftop night dissolves into his small dim student room: he lies on the narrow bed staring at the ceiling, one arm behind his head, restless; the desk lamp burns low over unopened books.

Her bedroom dissolves into the long formal dining table: she sits alone with her silent parents, staring at her untouched plate, pushing food without eating; the chandelier cold; nobody speaks.

clips.motion: THE REUNION: a waking morning market street in soft early light; he wanders in from the left among the stalls, she from the right; across the crowd their eyes find each other and both freeze - then her face breaks open and SHE RUNS to him.
She crashes into his arms; the fierce embrace holds and holds among the stalls, her face buried in his shoulder, his hand in her hair, both laughing and crying at once; the market flows around them.
